detail.body:
Add examples/megatron/models/gpt-oss/run_gpt_oss_mi455x.sh, a single-node 4x MI455X (gfx1250) launcher for GPT-OSS 20B and the 8-layer 120B proxy, plus a README with the v0 baseline and the known issues on amdprimus/amdprimus:tas-20261011.

The script starts the image from the host (or runs directly inside it) and applies the gfx1250 settings every run needs: PRIMUS_GPU_MODEL=MI455X, Triton expert scheduling off (env var plus a patch of Triton's default), the Triton Turbo attention backend and no GPU core dumps. 20B uses TE cross entropy because the native fused CE fails at step 1 on pinned host memory; the 120B proxy disables the yaml's torch profiler.

v0 baseline (EP4, mock data, iterations 3-10):
  GPT-OSS 20B        2114 ms/iter, 819 TFLOP/s/GPU, lm loss 11.34809
  GPT-OSS 120B proxy  447 ms/iter, 191 TFLOP/s/GPU, lm loss 11.39837

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+# GPT-OSS on MI455X (gfx1250)
+
+BF16 pretrain of GPT-OSS 20B and a GPT-OSS 120B proxy on one MI455X node (4 GPUs, mock data).
+`run_gpt_oss_mi455x.sh` reproduces the v0 baseline below.
+
+## Run
+
+From the host, the script starts `DOCKER_IMAGE` and re-runs itself inside it:
+
+```bash
+MODEL=20B  bash examples/megatron/models/gpt-oss/run_gpt_oss_mi455x.sh
+MODEL=120B bash examples/megatron/models/gpt-oss/run_gpt_oss_mi455x.sh
+```
+
+Inside an already running container, add `PRIMUS_LAUNCHER=direct`. The log is written to
+`output/<PRIMUS_TEAM>/<PRIMUS_USER>/<PRIMUS_EXP_NAME>/log_node0.txt`.
+
+| variable | default | meaning |
+|---|---|---|
+| `MODEL` | `20B` | `20B` (24 layers) or `120B` (8-of-36-layer proxy, full recompute) |
+| `DOCKER_IMAGE` | `amdprimus/amdprimus:tas-20261011` | image used by the container launcher |
+| `PRIMUS_LAUNCHER` | `container` | `container` (from the host) or `direct` (inside the container) |
+| `PRIMUS_EP` | `4` | expert parallel size; TP and PP are 1 |
+| `MBS`, `GBS` | 20B: `8`, `64`; 120B: `1`, `8` | micro / global batch size |
+| `TRAIN_ITERS` | `10` | |
+| `NUM_LAYERS` | `8` | 120B proxy only |
+| `CE_IMPL` | 20B: `te`; 120B: `native` | `--cross_entropy_fusion_impl` |
+| `EXTRA_ARGS` | | extra Megatron overrides, e.g. `--sink_sliding_window 128` |
+| `PATCH_TRITON_EXPERT_SCHEDULING` | `1` | patch Triton's gfx1250 expert-scheduling default off |
+
+## v0 baseline (2026-10-13)
+
+| model | layers | parallel | MBS / GBS | seq | ms/iter | TFLOP/s/GPU | tokens/s/GPU | lm loss @10 | peak memory |
+|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
+| GPT-OSS 20B | 24 | EP4 DP4 | 8 / 64 | 4096 | 2114 | 819 | 30,996 | 11.34809 | 393 GB (91%) |
+| GPT-OSS 120B proxy | 8 of 36 | EP4 DP4, full recompute | 1 / 8 | 4096 | 447 | 191 | 18,347 | 11.39837 | 201 GB (46%) |
+
+- Hardware: 4x MI455X, 432 GB each, one node.
+- Image: `amdprimus/amdprimus:tas-20261011`
+  (`sha256:e49a25905a2e05fd3009478e6601021f7c775da503811eb3634b36837e6bfad7`). It ships
+  torch 2.14.0+rocm10.2.0a20261011, Triton 3.8.0 and Transformer Engine 2.19.0.dev0.
+- Primus: `dev/mi455x_v1` at `ab873556` plus this script.
+- Primus-Turbo: the image's `1d47bb72` (FlyDSL 0.2.4) and `dev/mi455x_v1` `a1800137`
+  (FlyDSL 0.3.4.1) give the same numbers. GPT-OSS uses Turbo's Triton attention and RMSNorm
+  (`use_turbo_grouped_gemm: false`). The two commits differ only under `primus_turbo/flydsl`.
+- Numbers are Megatron's averages over iterations 3-10 of one run. Repeats:
+  - 20B, 5 runs: 2107.5-2114.6 ms. lm loss and grad norm (2.031) are bit-identical across runs.
+  - 120B proxy, 4 runs: 436.5-446.5 ms. Iteration 3 is sometimes slow (554 ms); iterations
+    4-10 run at about 430 ms.
+- Every run finished 10/10 iterations with 0 NaN and `check_for_nan_in_loss_and_grad` on.
+
+Shape: hidden 2880, 64 heads / 8 KV groups, 32 experts / top-4 for 20B (128 experts for 120B),
+vocab 131072 (padded to 131200). Routing uses the example yaml's
+`moe_router_force_load_balancing: true`.
+
+## Known issues on this image
+
+- **Triton expert scheduling.** Triton 3.8 enables `amdgpu-expert-scheduling-mode` for gfx1250,
+  which produces random memory faults or NaN in Turbo Triton kernels.
+  `TRITON_HIP_USE_EXPERT_SCHEDULING=0` alone still leaves some Inductor kernels in expert mode,
+  so the script also patches `is_expert_scheduling_enabled()` in Triton's AMD backend.
+- **GPU detection.** Primus reports the GPU as `AMD Radeon Graphics` and skips
+  `runner/helpers/envs/MI455X.sh` unless `PRIMUS_GPU_MODEL=MI455X` is set.
+- **20B native fused cross entropy fails at step 1** with `CUDA error: out of memory`. Inductor
+  compiles Megatron's native CE, and its autotuner backs up the 8x4096x131200 fp32 logits (about
+  17 GB per rank) into pinned host memory. Four ranks exceed the amdgpu pinned-memory limit. The
+  script uses TE cross entropy for 20B. At MBS 4, where native CE fits, both implementations run
+  clean: lm loss 11.34770 (native) vs 11.34772 (TE), and TE is about 1% faster.
+- **120B profiler.** The 120B example yaml enables the torch profiler, which kills the process
+  in `gilstate_tss_set` after training. The script disables it.
+- **Turbo in the image is not `dev/mi455x_v1`.** The image installs Turbo `1d47bb72` as a copy in
+  `site-packages`, not as an editable install of `/workspace/Primus-Turbo`. That build imports
+  `flydsl.expr.buffer_ops`, which FlyDSL 0.3.4.1 removed. Upgrading FlyDSL alone therefore breaks
+  Turbo, and the `dev/mi455x_v1` Python package has to replace the installed copy.
+- **20B NaN from the gfx1250 runbook did not reproduce.** The runbook reports Inf at iteration 1
+  for this 20B shape with Turbo attention. It did not occur in 8 runs here, all with the yaml
+  default `overlap_param_gather: true`. The runbook describes the bug as intermittent, so
+  keep the NaN check on.
+
+## Differences from the real GPT-OSS model
+
+v0 keeps the example yaml's model settings, so it stays comparable with the gfx1250 runbook:
+
+- `primus/configs/models/megatron/gpt_oss_{20B,120B}.yaml` add a shared expert
+  (`moe_shared_expert_intermediate_size: 2880`). GPT-OSS has none.
+- `sink_sliding_window: 0`, so every layer is full causal attention with sinks. GPT-OSS uses a
+  128-token window on even layers (`EXTRA_ARGS="--sink_sliding_window 128"`). The Turbo Triton
+  kernel implements the window as a mask: it still visits every causal K block in the forward and
+  both backward kernels. With the window on, 20B runs 10/10 with 0 NaN and lm loss 11.10439, but
+  takes 2140 ms/iter instead of 2114: the window changes numerics and saves no compute.
+- The vocabulary is 131072; GPT-OSS uses 201088.

@@ -0,0 +1,122 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+# GPT-OSS BF16 pretrain on one MI455X (gfx1250) node, 4 GPUs, mock data.
+# v0 baseline for dev/mi455x_v1; results and known issues are in README.md.
+#
+#   From the host (starts DOCKER_IMAGE and re-runs this script inside it):
+#     MODEL=20B  bash examples/megatron/models/gpt-oss/run_gpt_oss_mi455x.sh
+#     MODEL=120B bash examples/megatron/models/gpt-oss/run_gpt_oss_mi455x.sh
+#   Already inside the container:
+#     PRIMUS_LAUNCHER=direct MODEL=20B bash examples/megatron/models/gpt-oss/run_gpt_oss_mi455x.sh
+#
+# MODEL=20B  is the full 24-layer model, EP4, MBS8 / GBS64.
+# MODEL=120B is an 8-of-36-layer proxy, EP4, MBS1 / GBS8, full recompute.
+# Extra Megatron overrides go in EXTRA_ARGS, e.g. EXTRA_ARGS="--sink_sliding_window 128".
+set -euo pipefail
+
+HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+REPO="$(cd "${HERE}/../../../.." && pwd)"
+cd "${REPO}"
+
+export MODEL=${MODEL:-20B}
+export DOCKER_IMAGE=${DOCKER_IMAGE:-amdprimus/amdprimus:tas-20261011}
+export PRIMUS_LAUNCHER=${PRIMUS_LAUNCHER:-container}
+export PRIMUS_TEAM=${PRIMUS_TEAM:-amd}
+export PRIMUS_USER=${PRIMUS_USER:-$(whoami)}
+
+if [ "${PRIMUS_LAUNCHER}" = "container" ]; then
+  ENV_ARGS=()
+  for v in MODEL PRIMUS_TEAM PRIMUS_USER PRIMUS_EXP_NAME PRIMUS_EP HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES GPUS_PER_NODE \
+           TRAIN_ITERS MBS GBS NUM_LAYERS CE_IMPL EXTRA_ARGS PATCH_TRITON_EXPERT_SCHEDULING \
+           TRITON_HIP_USE_EXPERT_SCHEDULING PRIMUS_TURBO_ATTN_BACKEND HSA_COREDUMP_PATTERN HF_TOKEN; do
+    if [ -n "${!v+x}" ]; then ENV_ARGS+=(-e "${v}"); fi
+  done
+  DEVICE_ARGS=(--device /dev/kfd --device /dev/dri)
+  if [ -e /dev/infiniband ]; then DEVICE_ARGS+=(--device /dev/infiniband); fi
+  echo "[gpt-oss] launching ${MODEL} in ${DOCKER_IMAGE}"
+  # Same runtime options as `primus-cli container` (runner/.primus.yaml).
+  exec docker run --rm --name "gpt-oss-mi455x-$$" \
+    --ipc host --network host --privileged --group-add video \
+    --cap-add SYS_PTRACE --cap-add CAP_SYS_ADMIN --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
+    --ulimit nofile=1048576:1048576 "${DEVICE_ARGS[@]}" \
+    -v "${REPO}:${REPO}" -w "${REPO}" "${ENV_ARGS[@]}" -e PRIMUS_LAUNCHER=direct \
+    "${DOCKER_IMAGE}" bash "${HERE}/$(basename "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
+fi
+
+########################## gfx1250 runtime settings ##########################
+# Primus reports the GPU as "AMD Radeon Graphics" and would skip runner/helpers/envs/MI455X.sh.
+export PRIMUS_GPU_MODEL=${PRIMUS_GPU_MODEL:-MI455X}
+# Triton 3.8 enables amdgpu-expert-scheduling-mode for gfx1250 by default, which causes random
+# memory faults / NaN in Turbo Triton kernels. The env var alone misses some Inductor kernels,
+# so Triton's default is also patched below (PATCH_TRITON_EXPERT_SCHEDULING=0 to skip).
+export TRITON_HIP_USE_EXPERT_SCHEDULING=${TRITON_HIP_USE_EXPERT_SCHEDULING:-0}
+# The default Turbo attention backend tries aiter, which the image does not ship.
+export PRIMUS_TURBO_ATTN_BACKEND=${PRIMUS_TURBO_ATTN_BACKEND:-triton}
+# A GPU fault otherwise writes a multi-GB core file per rank into the working directory.
+export HSA_COREDUMP_PATTERN=${HSA_COREDUMP_PATTERN:-/dev/null}
+
+if [ "${PATCH_TRITON_EXPERT_SCHEDULING:-1}" = "1" ]; then
+  TRITON_AMD_COMPILER="$(python -c 'import os, triton; print(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(triton.__file__), "backends", "amd", "compiler.py"))')"
+  if grep -q '^def is_expert_scheduling_enabled(arch):' "${TRITON_AMD_COMPILER}" &&
+     ! grep -A1 '^def is_expert_scheduling_enabled(arch):' "${TRITON_AMD_COMPILER}" | grep -q '^    return False$'; then
+    sed -i '/^def is_expert_scheduling_enabled(arch):/a\    return False' "${TRITON_AMD_COMPILER}"
+    echo "[gpt-oss] patched ${TRITON_AMD_COMPILER}: is_expert_scheduling_enabled() -> False"
+  fi
+fi
+
+################################ Parallelism #################################
+export NNODES=1
+export GPUS_PER_NODE=${GPUS_PER_NODE:-4}
+export HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0,1,2,3}
+export PRIMUS_TP=1
+export PRIMUS_PP=1
+export PRIMUS_EP=${PRIMUS_EP:-4}
+
+case "${MODEL}" in
+  20B)
+    EXP=examples/megatron/configs/MI355X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml
+    MBS=${MBS:-8}
+    GBS=${GBS:-64}
+    # The native fused CE is compiled by Inductor, whose autotuner backs up the
+    # 8x4096x131200 fp32 logits (~17 GB per rank) into pinned host memory; four ranks
+    # exceed the amdgpu pinned-memory limit and step 1 fails with "CUDA error: out of memory".
+    CE_IMPL=${CE_IMPL:-te}
+    MODEL_ARGS=()
+    ;;
+  120B)
+    EXP=examples/megatron/configs/MI355X/gpt_oss_120B-BF16-pretrain.yaml
+    MBS=${MBS:-1}
+    GBS=${GBS:-8}
+    CE_IMPL=${CE_IMPL:-native}
+    # The yaml enables the torch profiler, which kills the process in gilstate_tss_set
+    # after training on this image.
+    MODEL_ARGS=(
+      --pipeline_model_parallel_size 1 --expert_model_parallel_size "${PRIMUS_EP}"
+      --num_layers "${NUM_LAYERS:-8}"
+      --recompute_granularity full --recompute_method uniform --recompute_num_layers 1
+      --profile False --use_pytorch_profiler False
+    )
+    ;;
+  *)
+    echo "[gpt-oss] unknown MODEL=${MODEL}, expected 20B or 120B" >&2
+    exit 1
+    ;;
+esac
+
+export PRIMUS_EXP_NAME=${PRIMUS_EXP_NAME:-gpt_oss_${MODEL}_mi455x_v0_ep${PRIMUS_EP}_mbs${MBS}_gbs${GBS}}
+LOGDIR="${REPO}/output/${PRIMUS_TEAM}/${PRIMUS_USER}/${PRIMUS_EXP_NAME}"
+mkdir -p "${LOGDIR}"
+echo "[gpt-oss] model=${MODEL} gpus=${GPUS_PER_NODE} ep=${PRIMUS_EP} mbs=${MBS} gbs=${GBS} ce=${CE_IMPL} log=${LOGDIR}"
+
+# shellcheck disable=SC2086
+./primus-cli direct -- train pretrain --config "${EXP}" \
+  --train_iters "${TRAIN_ITERS:-10}" --mock_data True \
+  --micro_batch_size "${MBS}" --global_batch_size "${GBS}" \
+  --cross_entropy_fusion_impl "${CE_IMPL}" \
+  --disable_wandb True --disable_tensorboard True \
+  "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}" ${EXTRA_ARGS:-} \
+  2>&1 | tee "${LOGDIR}/log_node0.txt"
